title: Group anagram names
hints: Pattern: canonical key. Turn each name into a form that is identical for all its anagrams, then group by that form in a dict.
"".join(sorted(name)) is the same string for 'listen', 'silent' and 'enlist'.
dict.setdefault(key, []).append(name) builds the groups; Python dicts keep insertion order, so list(groups.values()) is already in first-appearance order.
